disclosure: Fictional demo — no real accounts or payments.
audience: A person who pays the household bills and wants to see where the money goes each month.
purpose: Show what the ledger does and get the visitor to start a free ledger.
facts: Lumen Ledger sorts every bill into one of 12 groups, such as rent, food and travel.
Plans cost $4 a month after a 30-day free trial.
It compares this month's spending with last month's.
A reminder arrives seven days before each bill is due.
Each ledger keeps a ten-year history.
The family add-on is $6 a month for up to four people.
